basis.decisions: The owner's draft order of 2026-10-20 (Let's do your recommendation) commissions this DRAFT only; the freeze and any execution are separate owner decisions. The contract implemented is the PRED-2026-010 registration (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md, registered 2026-10-13) with its derivation record (reports/pred010_derivation_record.json).

criterion.pass_structure: with 3 trained signs the share can only be 0, 1/3, 2/3, or 1; the 70% bar passes only at 3 of 3

design.crosswalk_reading: the frozen Phase-396 build's fix_crosswalk reading: a trained sign's counterparts are the glyphs whose crosswalk row names it as best_parpola_match; top3_parpola alternatives never create a counterpart and set the conflict flag instead (DD-035-5)
design.disclosure: the Yajnadevam Harappa pool was previously inspected in aggregate during the Spec 032 closure audit (970 Harappa inscriptions in the old combined training corpus, carrying 1,013 occurrences of 11 of PRED-2026-006's 12 trained signs); no Harappa start rate has ever been computed for any sign; the cleanliness claimed is verified training-pool exclusion, not analyst blindness
design.draft_stage_coverage_observation: under that reading on the pinned crosswalk: P217 -> glyph Y0520 (confidence 1.0, confirmed); P324 -> glyph Y0740 (confidence 0.9867, confirmed); P000 has no best-match counterpart (top-3 alternative only, on the rows for Y0527, Y0740, Y0820, Y0892) - step 0 check 0.4 is therefore expected to close the study as CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN, unscored; the formal determination remains a step-0 act
design.execution_gate: the owner's freeze order for this contract, the freeze PR merged, and a separate execution order; step 0 re-verifies the OSF registration before any run
design.method: positional classification only (SA-free): for each trained sign, through the frozen crosswalk, its start rate at Harappa is the share of its Harappa occurrences in the withheld sequences in which it stands in initial position (the first sign of a sequence); a mappable trained sign with zero Harappa occurrences counts as not meeting the bar (DD-035-2); the per-sign table is published descriptively and carries no criterion
